scope: scripts/probe_technology_versions.py on a frozen Debug build of 87c4d8b1 (artifacts/w2bn2, git archive), 74/74 steps, in one owned scratch with CPU 1511-1 PN 6ES7 511-1AL03-0AB0/V4.1 (scratch), CPU 1511C-1 PN 6ES7 511-1CK01-0AB0/V2.6 and CPU 1214C DC/DC/DC 6ES7 214-1AG40-0XB0/V4.7 (both added from the installed catalog with configureScratchSecurity). 45 cells, each one to_create of TvProbe with unprofiledAcknowledged, applied with checkpoint and without compile or save, read back through technology_read and returned to the baseline (blocks, types, tag tables and technology objects of every PLC equal): 37 by change_restore into a new directory, 8 accepted motion creates by closing the owned Portal unsaved and reopening the checkpointed project, because the uncompiled first motion object leaves the generated MC_Servo inconsistent and the post-apply fingerprint refuses (FingerprintUnavailable). Accepted: CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 PID_Compact 3.0, PID_3Step 2.3, PID_Temp 1.1, TO_PositioningAxis, TO_SpeedAxis, TO_SynchronousAxis, TO_ExternalEncoder 10.0, High_Speed_Counter 5.0; CPU 1511C-1 PN V2.6 PID_Compact 2.4, PID_3Step 2.3, PID_Temp 1.1, TO_PositioningAxis, TO_SpeedAxis, TO_SynchronousAxis, TO_ExternalEncoder 4.0, High_Speed_Counter 5.0; CPU 1214C V4.7 PID_Compact 2.3, PID_3Step 2.3, PID_Temp 1.1, TO_PositioningAxis 8.0, TO_CommandTable 8.0. Refused by V21 at Create with its native text: every newer candidate tried before an accepted version (type or version does not exist), TO_Cam at the CPU's motion version and TO_SpeedAxis 8.0 on the S7-1200 (does not exist), TO_MeasuringInput and TO_OutputCam on both S7-1500 (cannot be created by Openness).
limitations: Three CPUs; versions tried newest first until one was accepted, so older versions a CPU may also accept stay unprofiled. Creation at the PLC root only: no compile, connection, parameters, children or behavior.

V21 refuses root creation of TO_MeasuringInput and TO_OutputCam (Technology objects of that type cannot be created by Openness); they are children of an axis or encoder (to_child_create, not probed here).
